title: Evolve and sustain KM capabilities
goal: The ways the venture keeps knowledge are still being used: each is read against its measure, the ones that are skipped are simplified or dropped, and what the venture now keeps matches what it now needs to answer.

steps.do: Read each capture step against its measure, and for every one that is skipped more often than it runs either cut what it asks for or drop it from the process record, saying which and why.
When a question is answered from a record the venture already had, say so in the answer and name the record, so the cost of keeping it is visible to whoever pays it.

Name where the way knowledge is kept is now too small for the work, a folder nobody can search, a glossary that two functions disagree about, a source list longer than anyone reads, and hand the tool part to the IT function.

consider.why: What held a one-person venture's knowledge stops holding it once there are more records than one person can remember.
consider.when: A record could not be found, or two records disagree about the same fact.

steps.do: Raise to the founder any record the venture should stop keeping or archive, since removing knowledge cannot be undone, and to the strategy lead what to simplify next.

done_criteria.check: Has every capture step that is skipped more often than it runs been either simplified or dropped, with the reason written?
